_meta.batch: Sinthia (pelne imie: Sinthia Seafoam) - poczatek luku postaci: 01 INTRO (17) + 02 YOURSELF (29) = 46 terminow.
_meta.character_voice: Sinthia: mloda (18 lat), teatralna, przesadnie dramatyczna kapitan - duzo wykrzyknikow, samozachwytu, dzieciecego uporu.

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: It is I, Sinthia Seafoam! [h]Fearless[/h] Captain of the Mortuga Submarine.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: To ja, Sinthia Seafoam! [h]Nieustraszona[/h] kapitan łodzi podwodnej Mortuga.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Aha! Then [h]you[/h] must be Detective Grimoire.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: A-ha! Czyli [h]ty[/h] musisz być detektywem Grimoire.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: [i]The world's greatest detective[/i], here, on my submarine-
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: [i]Najlepszy detektyw na świecie[/i], tutaj, na mojej łodzi podwodnej-
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en:
[i]The world's-[/i]
No no I'm not the world's greatest, just [h]a[/h] detective.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl:
[i]Na świecie-[/i]
Nie, nie, nie jestem najlepszym na świecie, po prostu [h]jakimś[/h] detektywem.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Uh, she was probably talking about [h]me?[/h]
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Now, I assume you've come to make your official report?
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: A teraz, zakładam, że przybyliście złożyć oficjalny raport?
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Let's hear it - I'm a busy woman, you know!
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: We just came in here to [i]question[/i] you - since you're one of the suspects.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: Przyszliśmy tu, żeby cię [i]przesłuchać[/i] - w końcu jesteś jedną z podejrzanych.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Yeah, no - that doesn't get you off the hook, I'm afraid.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: No właśnie nie - obawiam się, że to cię nie zwalnia z podejrzeń.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: Hey, so - thanks for finally letting us in.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: Hej, więc - dzięki, że w końcu nas wpuściłaś.
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.en: You know, I have to say, that [i]really was[/i] pretty unhelpful-
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.pl: Wiesz, muszę powiedzieć, że to [i]naprawdę nie[/i] pomogło-
Conversation/Sinthia 01 INTRO/Section ds.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: So... how'd you end up as the new captain?
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: [i]-it's all above board, okay??[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I didn't say it wasn't.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Sinthia, what were you [i]before[/i] you became captain? D'you have any credentials?
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Sinthia, kim byłaś [i]zanim[/i] zostałaś kapitanem? Masz jakieś kwalifikacje?
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Fifteen years experience as a nautical engineer and shipyard mechanic. Family business.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Piętnaście lat doświadczenia jako inżynier morski i mechanik stoczniowy. Rodzinny biznes.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: You don't look much older than fifteen [h]now.[/h]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Teraz [h]też[/h] nie wyglądasz na wiele więcej niż piętnaście lat.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en:
...
I'm [h]eight[/h]een!! [i]Ugh.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: How does an eighteen-year-old end up on a [i]submarine?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Jak to się dzieje, że osiemnastolatka trafia na [i]łódź podwodną?[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I came by rowing boat.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Correct.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Wait, the rowing boat we saw up on the [i]fore deck?[/i] That's yours?
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Czekaj, ta łódka wiosłowa, którą widzieliśmy na [i]pokładzie dziobowym?[/i] To twoja?
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: That's not really what I meant-
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Nie do końca o to mi chodziło-
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: ...I'll add it to the list.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: You should know, it's in bad shape. And it's missing an oar.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Powinnaś wiedzieć, że jest w kiepskim stanie. I brakuje jej wiosła.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: So how come you wanted to hire Grimoire?
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Because! There's a [h]murderer[/h] in our ranks... and they must be rooted [i]out![/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Bo! W naszych szeregach jest [h]morderca[/h]... i trzeba go [i]wytropić![/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: So - what d'you want us to [i]do[/i] exactly?
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: [h]One[/h] - you will investigate and ascertain the identity of the killer...
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: [h]Po pierwsze[/h] - zbadacie sprawę i ustalicie tożsamość zabójcy...
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: [h]Two[/h] - you will return here and report your findings to me.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: [h]Po drugie[/h] - wrócicie tutaj i zdacie mi raport z ustaleń.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Three, you go home.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en:
Three, you [h]pay[/h] us.
[h]Four,[/h] we go home.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl:
Po trzecie, [h]płacisz[/h] nam.
[h]Po czwarte,[/h] idziemy do domu.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Three, she pays us, four, we go get [i]ice-cream[/i], [h]five[/h] we go home.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.pl: Po trzecie, płaci nam, po czwarte, idziemy na [i]lody[/i], [h]po piąte[/h] idziemy do domu.
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: [h]Deal![/h]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Meeting adjourned!
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: I didn't actually say [i]anything.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: Wait, I didn't-
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.en: It's just the way it's meant to [i]be.[/i]
Conversation/Sinthia 02 YOURSELF/Section.speaker: Sinthia
